name: Elia for WPML
author: Elhuyar

sections.description:
Elia for WPML is a plugin that enables the use of Elia Elhuyar’s machine translator services within WPML.

This plugin simply adds the option to use Elia as a translation provider in WPML. Therefore, it is essential to have the WPML plugin installed beforehand.

Once WPML is installed and activated, install and activate Elia for WPML. Upon activation, a form will appear. After filling out the form, we will get in touch with you to provide the necessary credentials to use Elia in WPML/WordPress.

Requirements

  • WPML plugin must be installed and activated.
  • No additional PHP extensions are required (e.g., cURL is not needed).
sections.installation:
1. Unzip the plugin files.
  2. Upload the entire folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Fill in the form that appears after activation.
  5. Wait for us to contact you with your credentials.
sections.faq:
Do I need to install WPML first?

Yes. WPML is required for this plugin to work.

Is Elia a free service?

No. Elia is a professional translation service. You will receive pricing and credential information after registering.

Does this plugin connect to external services?

Yes. After activation and configuration, it connects to Elia’s translation API.
